# F1+F3 (docs/rv32_ROADMAP.md): the driver respects the ELF's class (rv32/rv64).
#   - fast  auto-picks qemu-system-riscv32/64 from the ELF (and runs it).
#   - cycle/hybrid reject an ELF whose class != the engine's xlen, both ways,
#     with one shared clear error and WITHOUT launching the engine.
# Independent, gated sections: rv64 always; the rv32 directions need
# HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32 (build the rv32 fixture) and skip cleanly without it.
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"   # fail/ok + cfg_val/vsim_bin_dir

bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
elf=$(ls "$ROOT"/tests/fixtures/handoff_roundtrip.elf 2>/dev/null \
      || ls "$ROOT"/tests/fixtures/*.elf 2>/dev/null | head -1)
[ -x "$BIN" ] && [ -n "$elf" ] || fail "need build/andesim + a fixture ELF"

BINDIR=$(vsim_bin_dir)

# --- A. fast: an rv64 ELF auto-selects qemu-system-riscv64 (no --engine) ------
out=$(timeout 30 "$BIN" run --mode fast --dry-run "$elf" 2>&1)
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'qemu-system-riscv64' \
  || fail "fast did not auto-pick riscv64 for an rv64 ELF: $out"
ok "fast: rv64 ELF -> qemu-system-riscv64"

# --- B. rv64 ELF on the rv32 engine (d23) -> clear error, no run --------------
#   cycle uses the shared ELF/engine arch check; hybrid rejects it even earlier
#   (its QEMU fast leg is rv64-only). Both exit 2 with a clear error, no run.
if [ -x "$BINDIR/sim_d23" ]; then
  expect 2 "ELF is rv64 but engine 'vsim:d23' is rv32" \
    timeout 30 env VSIM_BIN_DIR="$BINDIR" "$BIN" run --mode cycle \
    --engine vsim:d23 "$elf"
  ok "cycle: rv64 ELF on vsim:d23 (rv32) -> arch-mismatch error, no run"

  expect 2 'the hybrid fast leg \(QEMU\) is rv64-only' \
    timeout 30 env VSIM_BIN_DIR="$BINDIR" "$BIN" run --mode hybrid \
    --trigger marker --engine vsim:d23 "$elf"
  ok "hybrid: rv64 ELF on vsim:d23 (rv32) -> rv64-only fast-leg error, no run"
else
  ok "SKIP rv64-on-rv32: no sim_d23 under $BINDIR"
fi

  >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "rv32 fixture build failed"

printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'qemu-system-riscv32' \
  || fail "fast did not auto-pick riscv32 for an rv32 ELF: $out"
ok "fast: rv32 ELF -> qemu-system-riscv32"

QD=$(cfg_val QEMU_BIN_DIR)
if [ -x "$QD/qemu-system-riscv32" ]; then
